policies.D4: logit + log(original prepared training count / total training rows); tau=1; no search.
policies.D5_decision: Original Normal predictions unchanged. Original attack prediction retained only when its mean 10-NN distance is strictly below that class threshold, else Normal. D4 and D5 are separate treatments.
policies.D5_distance: Arithmetic mean of the 10 smallest Euclidean distances in float64.
policies.D5_embedding: Raw 128-dimensional final MLP penultimate ReLU activations, no normalization.
policies.D5_leakage: No test labels/features used in reference or threshold construction; no hyperparameter search.
policies.D5_reference: Exact Replay final checkpoint buffer, selected randomly within each class at its introduction; no old full training pool is added.
policies.D5_threshold: Per-class 95th percentile of reference-to-reference mean 10-NN distances, diagonal self row excluded; linear quantile; duplicates remain legitimate other rows.
policies.scientific_limit: D5 deliberately suppresses attack predictions as a diagnostic; it is not a non-suppressive RQ3 mechanism.
policies.scope: Final checkpoint only; full prepared ID test split; no shift test or retraining.
